name: GitLab CI/CD
summary: GitLab CI/CD is built into the GitLab platform and driven by a .gitlab-ci.yml file. Free includes 400 compute minutes a month, Premium costs $29 per user a month billed annually with 10,000 minutes, and extra minutes cost $10 per 1,000. The top tier is quote only.

facts.text: Compute minutes per month are 400 on Free, 10,000 on Premium and 50,000 on Ultimate.
Extra compute minutes cost $10 per 1,000, as a one-time payment, on any plan.
Deployments appear in an environment only after a deployment job in the pipeline has created them.
The job log page shows a Show complete raw option. It says timestamps add about 10% to log storage.
